profile.headline: Quality Manager • Operational Excellence Driver • Process Advocate • Change Champion • Mentor
profile.jobTitle: IT Manager, Software Engineer in Test
profile.summary:
My name is Anthony Saenz and my mission is to help organizations achieve Operational Excellence by focusing on improving Quality across the board.

I started my career in IT as a Help Desk Technician in 2009. However, my interest in computers started much earlier when I got my first personal computer, a Macintosh. From there, it blossomed into building my own PCs and studying computer science. 

I had no idea where my interest would take me, but since then, I have built my career in Information Technology, both in software and business. I spent the bulk of my career working in the Software Development Lifecycle in Quality Control creating Test Plans and Automated Test Scripts. Most recently, I have been working as an IT Manager, Software Development Engineer in Test at General Motors.

I consider myself a "people person" and not your stereotypical, head down, IT professional. I pride myself in being a chameleon, adapting to situations and people, to foster the best experiences. My passion is helping others realize and achieve their professional goals. Any leader worth their salt should know and want their employees to move on to new opportunities and roles.

positions.title: IT Manager, Software Engineer in Test
Manager, IT Quality Management
positions.description: IT Quality Manager responsible for improving Quality Assurance and Control for Bexar County Offices, Departments, and Citizens.

positions.title: Test Engineering Specialist
positions.description: Functional Testing Lead who manages a team of testing resources and oversees planning, construction, and execution of test scripts.  Apply business and functional knowledge including testing standards, guidelines, and testing methodology to meet the team's overall test objectives.  Maintain professional relationship with client resources to cultivate a strong working partnership for future business opportunities. Report to internal management and clients on testing progress using reports generated from HP Application Lifecycle Management software.  Train new resources on testing methodology and standards.  Give instructions on automation testing methods using HP UFT.

positions.title: Senior Test Analyst
positions.description: Provide expertise in the planning, construction, and execution of functional and regression test scripts. Apply business and functional knowledge including testing standards, guidelines, and testing methodology to meet the team's overall test objectives. Ensure all testing results are easily accessible and understandable. Track defects using HP Application Lifecycle Management to closure and keep defect repository up-to-date. Apply testing knowledge to plan, construct, and execute automated test scripts using the tool HP Unified Functional Tester. Present regression and performance testing suites to the client for approval. Execute test suite during System Test and UAT changes of applications in agile testing environments.  As a Project Manager, train new resources on testing methodology, as well as give instruction on how to automate test cases using HP UFT.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk Technician
positions.description: Provide complete helpdesk support for multiple clients.  Main client required support for over 250 users in three different South Texas cities.  Daily tasks included troubleshooting hardware and software for desktops, laptops, printers, warehouse technology, and servers.  Coordinate backups of network fileshares and servers.
